charts.title: growth-division-spatial-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 36-tick growth-division run: every live CPM cell on a shared 60x60 glucose Δ-from-t0 depletion panel (P1-c fix -- the field starts abundant and near-uniform, so the raw heatmap used to render as flat saturated yellow with invisible contours; the delta is where growth-driven consumption actually shows), each cell drawn as a translucent footprint fill + contour colored by lineage/generation (founder hue + a per-generation shade step, via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz._lineage_colors` over the `generation`/`max_generation` observables `CpmGrowthDivision` emits -- not a small palette that recycles once the population passes ~6 cells), growing as its per-footprint dFBA metabolism produces biomass, then splitting into two daughters via native divide_cells once it crosses vol_threshold. Every division tick is stamped directly into the frame title as it fires. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_growth_division_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: growth-division-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly time-series panel of the same 36-tick run, synced to the GIF's time axis: n_cells and total_volume over the full run, plus every division event (the same tick markers the GIF frame titles carry) as dashed vertical lines. n_cells steps up in a monotonic non-decreasing staircase while total_volume tracks the compounding population -- the full grow-cross-divide-resume arc made directly visible. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.
